The '''Kor Hunamma system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and was part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] section of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Kor Usilic system/Legends|Kor Usilic]] and [[Kor Utoradii system/Legends|Kor Utoradii systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Kor Hunamma system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Kor Hunamma]], the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Hunamma ]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="TEA Kor Hunamma" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kor Hunamma system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
